title: stephanandra incisa var. quadrifissa
intro: Stephanandra incisa var. quadrifissa, commonly known as Japanese stephanandra, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Stephanandra incisa var. quadrifissa are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood circulation and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
